Continuing Scenario

Your Project: The Meridian Move

Use only these starting facts until your instructor releases new information.

START HERE

Project

Consolidate two aging offices into the Meridian Building in 12 weeks.

Sponsor

The COO. Zero customer disruption is the expectation.

Team + Constraints

Volunteers from IT, Facilities, HR, and Operations. Modest budget. Fixed lease end date. Day jobs continue.

Your role: You are coordinating the work without relying on a formal Project Manager title.
